after.requirement: Compile a manual-callout regex with PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT and obtain PCRE2_ERROR_CALLOUT_CALLER_DISABLED.
after.reason: The after-source accepts the extra option and rejects manual callouts when it is set. The old harness supplies the pattern but never sets compile extra options.

source_evidence.quote:
PCRE2_EXTRA_NEVER_CALLOUT
If this option is set, PCRE2 treats callouts in the pattern as a syntax error, returning PCRE2_ERROR_CALLOUT_CALLER_DISABLED. This is useful if the application knows that a callout will not be provided to pcre2_match(), so that callouts in the pattern are not silently ignored.

claims.reason: The tuple is unchanged across sides. The before-source has no supported never-callout state or corresponding error; the after-source adds both. The old harness configuration is fixed on both sides.
